thread:
Eva (Sales): Warm pass 1-seat pilot with VantageMD signed today. They want private VPC, Okta SSO, and audit logs forwarded to their Splunk. Go-live target: 2025-08-12.
Diego (CS): Nice  assigning CS lead now. Who is procurement and security contact? Any blackout/maintenance windows?
Eva (Sales): Procurement is ops@vantage-md.com, security contact = nate@vantage-md.com. They requested maintenance windows 02:00-05:00 PT only. Contract link: https://redwood.app/contr/vantage-009
Leah (Solutions): Need Okta metadata and redirect_uris. Also confirm whether they want model auto-updates during the pilot (recommend OFF).
Samir (Eng): I'll own infra readiness and acceptance tests. Please open a triage ticket with expected QPS, avg token size, model family, and two sample payloads. Tag as P2 private-deploy.
Diego (CS): Created INF-5001 and added owners. onboard-bot: "Ticket INF-5001 created by Diego (CS) — Onboarding: VantageMD — owners: Diego, Samir, Leah"
onboard-bot: "Linked sales contract: https://redwood.app/contr/vantage-009 (read-only)"
Eva (Sales): Customer requests: daily spend alert, weekly SLA digest, and a retention policy for logs (90 days). They prefer dedicated GPU pool for predictable latency.
Samir (Eng): For pilot, recommend 2x a10g-equivalent to start. Smoke test plan: `wrk -t6 -c60 -d45s /v1/chat` with ~140 token avg and a 3m soak at 50 concurrent. If they ask for a 5m spike test, plan for 120 concurrent.
Leah (Solutions): Example Okta snippet I asked them to supply:
```
issuer: https://vantage.okta.com
client_id: 0oa1VANTAGEabc
redirect_uris:
  - https://app.vantage-md.com/_auth/okta/callback
```
Diego (CS): CS runbook items: 1) Kickoff + compliance scoping call with Nate 2) Capture prompt library and acceptance prompts 3) Share health dashboard on day 3 and weekly thereafter 4) Set cost alerts and add SLA digest to their inbox.
Eva (Sales): I'll nudge Nate for the Okta metadata and sample payloads today. Also will confirm their Splunk endpoint and S3 bucket ARN for logs.
Samir (Eng): Please add their expected concurrent sessions and average tokens to INF-5001. I'll draft the runbook: env vars, cert exchange steps, smoke test commands, rollback steps.
Diego (CS): Renewal/risk note: pilot auto-converts to annual if usage > 80k tokens/mo by month 4 OR uptime > 99.0%. Let's track early health metrics (p50/p95 latency, error rate, tokens/day) and report at week 2.
Leah (Solutions): If they want DEBUG logs during pilot, warn about increased egress/storage; we'll set a temporary cost cap alert.
Samir (Eng): Engineering ask to customer (post in INF-5001): provide two representative payloads (happy + edge), an Okta test tenant, and expected peak daily users.
Diego (CS): Weekly sync cadence proposed: Fridays 9am PT until stable. I'll send calendar invite and attach INF-5001.
Eva (Sales): :thumbsup: thanks team. I'll follow-up on procurement docs and loop Nate into the kickoff.
Samir (Eng): Closing note  if dedicated GPUs are confirmed, schedule a 30m pre-cutover smoke test with a short spike (5m @ 120 concurrent). Update INF-5001 with any artifacts. If blocked before EOD Friday, DM Diego. :white_check_mark:
